commit_clusters.29692dabea40: insn-tablegen (RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td): f32 <-> v2i16/v4i8 bitconvert patterns for F and Zfinx

cluster_deviation: Task names owner_cluster codegen-core, but the root cause is missing ISel patterns next to the fork's existing i32<->v2i16/v4i8 bitconvert patterns in RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td, which belongs to insn-tablegen (scripts/fork_anatomy.py owner). No codegen-core file changed; no legalization change needed (the bitcast is Legal, only patterns were missing). Hunk is far from the LOOPsetup definitions (F028).
summary: B140: 'Cannot select: v2i16 = bitcast f32' is a pre-existing fork gap (ref-18 and port-19 crash too): the fork has i32<->v2i16/v4i8 bitconvert patterns (fork commit 93e0fc427e93) but none for f32. Added, in a foreach over (v2i16,GPRAV2),(v4i8,GPRAV4): F: fmv.x.w / fmv.w.x (+ register class copy); Zfinx: INSERT_SUBREG/EXTRACT_SUBREG sub_32 (no instruction), mirroring upstream RISCVInstrInfoF.td:715-716 and :721-722 at llvmorg-20.1.8. v2f16/v2bf16 are legalized to v2i16 and covered. Note: EXTRACT_SUBREG of a COPY_TO_REGCLASS is silently dropped by TableGen (impossible type) - the final pattern extracts sub_32 directly from GPRAV2/GPRAV4.
